description.zh: 串联时电流处处相同、电压按电阻分；并联时电压相同、电流按电阻反比分；比较等效电阻与灯泡个数的影响，拧下一个灯泡看串并联的差别，计算混联电路，并解释家庭电器并联、保险丝串联。直流、理想电源、恒定电阻的模型。
description.en: In series the current is the same and voltage divides by resistance; in parallel the voltage is the same and current divides inversely; compare equivalent resistance and the effect of the number of bulbs, unscrew a bulb to see the difference, solve a mixed circuit, and explain why house appliances are in parallel with a series fuse. DC, ideal source, fixed resistances.

label.en: From one loop to branching ones

reason.zh: 简单电路只有一个回路；本页第 0、1 步把它扩展为串联（一条通路）与并联（多条通路）。
reason.en: Simple circuits has one loop; steps 0 and 1 here extend it to series (one path) and parallel (several paths).

label.en: Applying I = V/R piece by piece

reason.zh: 第 4 步混联电路里每一段都用欧姆定律算电流和电压，并用 V₁+V₂₃=12 V 与 I₂+I₃=I 核对。
reason.en: In step 4 every part of the mixed circuit uses Ohm’s law, checked against V₁+V₂₃ = 12 V and I₂+I₃ = I.

title.zh: 为什么家里的灯一个坏了其他还亮？
title.en: Why do the other lights stay on when one bulb fails?

ask.zh: 串联时电流处处相同——拧下一个灯泡，整个回路的电流会怎样？
ask.en: In series the current is the same everywhere — unscrew one bulb, what happens to the current in the whole loop?

ask.zh: 并联时电压相同、电流按电阻反比分——家里一个灯坏了，其他灯的电压变了吗？为什么还亮？
ask.en: In parallel the voltage is the same and current divides inversely with resistance — when one home bulb fails, does the voltage on the others change? Why do they stay lit?

reveal.zh: 串联是一条路，断了全灭；并联是各走各的路，电压不变、各支路独立，所以一个坏了其他还亮——这就是家庭电器并联的原因。
reveal.en: Series is a single path — break it and all go dark; parallel gives each bulb its own path at the same voltage, independently, so one failing leaves the rest lit — which is why home appliances are wired in parallel.

note: simple-circuits and ohms-law are other fragment concepts (same batch family), not yet atlas nodes.
